text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/settings.py:1:moved-import", "app/settings.py:10:config-class"], "search": "from pydantic import BaseSettings, Field", "replace": "from pydantic import Field\nfrom pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict", "explanation": "BaseSettings moved out of pydantic into the pydantic-settings package (migration.md#basesettings-has-moved-to-pydantic-settings), so it is imported from pydantic_settings. SettingsConfigDict is imported for the settings config below, since it is the typed config dict for BaseSettings subclasses."}, {"finding_ids": ["app/settings.py:7:field-kwargs"], "search": "    database_url: str = Field(\"sqlite:///local.db\", env=\"INVENTORY_DB_URL\")", "replace": "    database_url: str = Field(\"sqlite:///local.db\", validation_alias=\"INVENTORY_DB_URL\")", "explanation": "The `env=` keyword was removed from Field in v2 (migration.md#changes-to-pydanticfield). pydantic-settings uses validation_alias as the exact environment variable name, so INVENTORY_DB_URL is read as before."}, {"finding_ids": ["app/settings.py:10:config-class"], "search": "    class Config:\n        env_prefix = \"INVENTORY_\"", "replace": "    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix=\"INVENTORY_\")", "explanation": "The v1 inner `class Config` is deprecated; config is set via a `model_config` class attribute (migration.md#changes-to-config). The key env_prefix is unchanged."}], "notes": "Edits applied in order and non-overlapping. Deviation from the finding text: the finding suggests ConfigDict, but BaseSettings subclasses should use pydantic-settings' SettingsConfigDict, which is typed for env_prefix. ConfigDict would also work at runtime, since model_config is a plain dict, but type checkers would flag env_prefix as an unknown key. Behavior note: in v1, `env=` left the constructor keyword as `database_url`. With validation_alias set, `Settings(database_url=...)` is no longer accepted unless validate_by_name/populate_by_name is enabled. load_settings() calls Settings() with no arguments, so nothing in this file is affected. If other callers pass database_url by keyword, add validate_by_name=True to the config (pydantic 2.11+) or populate_by_name=True. I did not add that, to keep the change minimal. The Settings class has no other v1 APIs, and the remaining fields need no changes."}
